scenarios.name: Inspect panel visibility from a minimized ribbon tab

scenario_steps.name: the top-docked ribbon is minimized to tabs with 3D Model active
the Modify panel is visible and Parameters is hidden
the user right-clicks the 3D Model tab
the submenu lists the 3D Model panels
Modify is checked and Parameters is unchecked
the ribbon remains minimized to tabs
the user clicks an empty area of the viewport
the ribbon remains minimized to tabs
